# Workflows

Default target: Clay

## Targets

### Clay

Author, validate, test, publish, run, and inspect through target-sandbox/clay/state.json. Live workflows use published logic. Data and runs live in Clay. Connections live in-app. Estimate credits before runs.

## Connections

### HubSpot

The connection lives in Clay as Production HubSpot. Writes cost no separate HubSpot credits.

## Limits

Maximum 3,000 Clay credits per run. Pilot 10 rows first.
